name: @opencode-pet/plugin
description: Local OpenCode event bridge and optional /pet TUI command for OpenCode Pet.

scripts.build: bun run --cwd ../protocol typecheck && bun build ./src/plugin.ts --outfile ./dist/opencode-pet.js --target bun --format esm && bun build ./src/tui.ts --outfile ./dist/opencode-pet-tui.js --target bun --format esm && tsc --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd ../protocol typecheck && tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --emitDeclarationOnly false
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run test
